reason: The hypothesis combines the known barrier effect of coherent interfaces on dislocation motion (from P11, P39, P42) with the creep behavior of FCC/BCC dual-phase HEAs (from P1), but applies it to a new material system (FCC/BCC protective coatings) and proposes a specific mechanism (coherent phase boundaries dynamically locking dislocations to simultaneously hamper climb and grain boundary sliding) that is not explicitly stated in any single passage. However, the core idea of using coherent interfaces to impede dislocations and enhance creep resistance is directly taken from the literature on γ/γ′ and FCC/BCC systems, and the proposed test is a standard comparative creep experiment.
